risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (291.5) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinationals, and Consumer Discretionary sector faces demand destruction in risk-off environment.

debate.key_bull_argument: EMA golden cross, MACD bullish crossover, and Ichimoku cloud breakout provide intermediate-term confluence in extreme fear environment (VIX crisis), offering contrarian swing entry near support with defined risk.
debate.key_bear_argument: Fundamental score of 2, macro environment severely unfavourable (inverted yield curve, VIX 291.5, strong dollar), price below 200-SMA, ADX weak (15.81), RSI not confirming, and high earnings risk within 61 days create asymmetric downside risk that outweighs technical signals.
